scope.known_issue: The exact official page was last checked 2026-09-01 and then showed stock and order controls; current status and price may have changed.

allowed_work: One Luna evidence-only worker may open only the exact official SPcycle G026 frameset URL once and report visible current purchase-route facts (stock label, Buy Now/Add to Cart controls, listed prices, options, and access date). No account, cart, checkout, seller contact, alternate model, third-party seller or additional route. The primary writer may add a dated source recheck, update this exact variant's purchase-route text and last_reviewed, and resolve the exact attempt only to the extent supported by the page.
stop_conditions: Stop after the single exact official page open; do not retry blocked, unavailable, or challenge routes.
Do not infer successful checkout, mainland shipping, final price, warranty, or current stock from a route control alone.
Do not change price observations unless the exact current page visibly presents a new amount and package basis; retain prior dated prices.
done_criteria: Current exact-page evidence is either recorded with all conditions or the route gap remains explicitly unresolved.
Fresh data:gaps and research:queue quantify the post-batch state.

Run validate, research:check, monotonic coverage acceptance/check and git diff --check; run the full npm run check gate once if source or catalog records change. No image report because no image record is in scope.
